## Finding disposition

Accepted and resolved by the original independent reporter after inspection of current Design sha256:f1bc20eb118394c626ea678afcb5d0938a20e8da5d5c08282bd82abe29045e4a and Workflow sha256:1b9a96c45a58766bc0317e2a64be41867837675036dda57eecc8dc7f4510ca92. DES-SR-12 and Model-owned example contract now explicitly require parent indexing, JSON parsing without explanatory extra keys, available-schema conformance for complete records, preservation of before/after invariants, and affected-example review with exact relied-on identities. The five source-obligation mapping rows state retention and name exact paragraph destinations; Workflow links to that single owner. The resource map assigns the complete method to conditional model-authoring guidance; DES-SR-16 handoff and input/identity/pair-invariant counterexamples retain observable consequences. DES-SR-13 explicitly includes unnumbered material obligations, addressing the transfer failure without new product direction. Independent boundary structure check passed; inspected design-authoring-checks records current prose/readability/link evidence. This is completed Design correction, with no deferral or residual-risk waiver and no claim that future skill implementation already exists. Original finding evidence, subjects and immutable origin remain unchanged.

## Complete package assessment

The full Design/System/Workflow package remains consistent with the accepted unified-authoring direction and the Constitution's adopted living-model profile. The refinement restores source obligations rather than changing product direction. Design owns behavior/realization reconciliation, stable model responsibility, decision rationale and the composition method; System owns the actual assembled relationships and integrated obligations; Workflow retains coordination. Review and Closeout and Test retain their distinct policy ownership. Separate historical architecture/specification/ADR packaging does not override the selected model profile; the prospective governance and consumer amendments remain required at coordinated adoption.

Behavior, technical realization and acceptance intent are mutually supportable. The compact skill core and conditional model, technical, composition, legacy, governed-recording and Test methods supply a feasible implementation structure without eager loading of two retired manuals. The example correction explicitly maps the same safeguards into that conditional resource and exact-subject handoff. It introduces neither a per-example record schema nor semantic validator nor a Design-stage test implementation requirement. A malformed/extra-key JSON example, schema-invalid complete record, unindexed example, invariant-breaking pair or stale relied-on example now has an explicit rejection or non-reliance outcome. Syntax-only success cannot establish the composed pair or assessment claim.

System's unchanged inventory, end-to-end scenarios, mixed-architecture section boundaries and retained-owner/follow-up map continue to compose with the corrected Design. Its local versus integrated proof distinction matches DES-SR-10/16 and Test. Workflow's corrected links preserve the old source anchors without a duplicate example-method owner. The existing v2 recording, policy, concurrency and correction responsibilities are unchanged. Shared semantic decisions remain actor-owned; the CLI still supplies selection, identities and storage, not readiness.

The architecture-method R1–R124 dispositions, two selected ADR rationale mappings, and exact mixed-system boundaries remain as reviewed in the first assessment. Their main source constraints and historical judgments are preserved or explicitly superseded; the new unnumbered-obligation criterion and five exact example rows cure the evidenced gap. The bounded installer entrypoint guard remains feasible at existing preflight/blocked-result boundaries, with old archives, user files, existing installer state protections and separate release/customer authority preserved. No broader runtime compatibility change is inferred from the refinement.

All accepted goals remain represented: one public design path and reconciled consumers; behavior plus realization plus decisions and verification intent; system/component cooperation without duplicate contracts; scoped authority migration; and explicit later ownership for remaining consolidation. The exact first slice and downstream local/integrated proof intent are adequate for Delivery allocation. All eight model dimensions remain classified; no requirement to enumerate every legitimate test or load every repository model is introduced. No further required correction or necessary unresolved decision was found.

## Evidence, applicability and limits

The initial assessment read every complete package member and relevant source contracts. This reassessment inspects the full revised Design, the complete Workflow diff against its previously inspected source and current replacement destinations, and retains the already-read unchanged System and dependency basis after fresh CLI identity inspection. Fifteen previously inspected subjects are unchanged, including System, proposal/review, Constitution, Test, Review and Closeout, both method ADRs, architecture-method/system sources and the inspected skill/installer constraints. The package judgment is newly made against current model identities; it does not retarget the old approval or silently dispose a finding.

The current design-authoring-checks evidence identifies all three corrected subjects and reports successful model/prose/readability checks with 140 readability warnings, 74 relative-link targets and exact R1–R124 enumeration. Those are bounded structural evidence. The updated material-decision entry explicitly identifies the old shared narrative as first-draft history; this review does not rely on its earlier counts or pending-finding statements as current status. The reviewer independently compared each of the five original finding obligations with its normative destination and counterexample, rather than using author mapping claims as approval.

Independently reran: python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/design/system/system.md --path docs/design/workflow/workflow.md (passed, structure-and-references-only). Record-store validation and git diff --check follow the save and are reported in the handoff. No implementation/adapter/init execution, full CI or target-agent behavior is claimed. The user's untracked docs/design.zip is outside the selected model package and is untouched. No project-map reliance is added; the first assessment's bounded direct-source rationale remains.

## Independence provenance

Original independent reporter task /root/independent_design_review, separately delegated from primary-agent. User supplied direction and requested refinement; primary-agent authored the initial and corrected Design/Workflow contributions and System. Reviewer authored no model contribution or correction and independently reassessed the exact full package and des-review-f1. Reusing this nonauthor reviewer preserves concrete independence; passing author checks or a role label do not establish it.
